options: Reserve Ceremonial Grade: five 30 g, JPY 15,200
Imperial Ceremonial Grade: seven 30 g, JPY 15,500
Signature Ceremonial Grade: eight 30 g, JPY 13,900
Premium Ceremonial Grade: six varieties, JPY 8,100
catalog.price: Samples ship at retail price with a 20% wholesale-sample discount

catalog.name: OEM private-label matcha pouches
catalog.notes: Plain 30 g matcha pouches meant to fit a brand's own tins, for buyers who add their own labels. Custom blending is not offered; the closest existing product is recommended instead.
options: 30 g pouch in Silver, Gold, Black or White
Minimum order: No minimum on pouches or tins
catalog.price: USD 1.50 per pouch

name: Whisk Matcha
summary: The "___ x Whisk" partnership program offers wholesale pricing to businesses.
facts: Includes a free trial, marketing support, training, recipe development and free local shipping or delivery
Email to get details
Partnership questions go to partners@whiskmatcha.ca
Product described on the page as ultra-premium organic matcha; no product names or sizes listed

catalog.name: Co-branded partnership program
catalog.notes: A co-branded wholesale partnership in which the business and Whisk jointly market ultra-premium organic matcha. Pricing and product details are not given on the page.

name: Yamamotoyama
summary: Tea company that sells by the case to resellers through an online business profile.
facts: A reseller's permit is required to buy by the case
Help creating a new online business profile is available at Wholesale@yamamotoyama.com
Other sales inquiries go to Sales@yamamotoyama.com

name: Yōko Matcha
summary: Sells Shizuoka matcha to cafés, restaurants and hospitality businesses in the US and internationally, with in-stock orders shipping from Miami.
facts: Sold in 500 g bags or cases of 48 bags (24 kg)
Says in-stock website orders ship the next business day
Lot testing for more than 200 pesticide residues; lot documentation available on request
No free samples; a 30 g ceremonial tin is sold for USD 30
Prices are in USD before shipping and taxes

catalog.name: Wholesale ceremonial matcha, 500 g bag
catalog.notes: First-harvest, single-cultivar ceremonial matcha, bead-milled in Japan, sold by the bag for smooth lattes and whisking with water.
options: Minimum order: One 500 g bag; no larger minimum
catalog.price: USD 160 per bag; USD 128 each with 2 or more bags (20% off, applied automatically in the cart)

catalog.name: Case of ceremonial matcha, 48 x 500 g
catalog.notes: A full case of the ceremonial matcha at a lower per-bag cost; the 2-bag discount does not apply to cases.
catalog.price: USD 4,320 per case (USD 90 per bag)

catalog.name: Wholesale culinary matcha, 500 g bag
catalog.notes: Third-harvest Yabukita matcha for baking, desserts and sweetened drinks.
catalog.price: USD 45 per bag; USD 36 each with 2 or more bags (20% off)

catalog.name: Pallet, white-label and custom packaging
catalog.notes: Larger and custom orders quoted individually through the contact form, with custom orders taking about two months from Japan.

name: Yunomi
summary: Japanese tea marketplace with a two-step wholesale membership (Lite, then Pro) for businesses that resell tea, including private label, drop shipping and OEM.
facts: Lite membership by application gives 30% off or more; Pro, after approval, is paid quarterly or yearly and gives up to 60% off some products
States there is no minimum order for any product; some items come in lots such as 10 x 1 kg cases
Custom production and private label generally start around ¥500,000
Requires clients to also offer non-matcha Japanese tea (from 2026)
Open to businesses that resell tea and to clubs that distribute tea to members
Shipping terms are FCA; in-stock orders take about 1 week, back-ordered items at least 4 weeks
Export permission required for purchases over JPY 200,000 (about one week, no charge)
Payment by credit card or international wire (WISE also accepted); JPY 4,000 wire handling fee under JPY 100,000
Wholesale accounts cannot use retail promotions or free-shipping offers
note: Sells these farms' teas; the program is Yunomi's.

catalog.name: Wholesale Lite membership
catalog.notes: Entry wholesale tier for businesses that resell tea, granted by application, with a discount on most products.
options: Minimum order: No minimum order for standard products
catalog.price: 30% off or more, depending on the product

catalog.name: Wholesale Pro membership
catalog.notes: Higher tier open to approved Lite members, with a paid recurring membership fee that is discounted for annual billing.
catalog.price: Up to 60% off some products; membership fee is non-refundable but can be cancelled at any time

catalog.name: Private labeling of matcha bags
catalog.notes: Adds a client's label to in-stock unlabeled matcha bags for a per-unit fee, or runs a custom production run.
options: Minimum order: Custom orders and private label generally start at JPY 500,000 (store credit can cover it)

catalog.name: 1 kg bulk tea units
catalog.notes: Bulk tea sold in 1 kg units from several suppliers; some items come in lots. Orders of 30 kg or more of one tea may qualify for renegotiated pricing.

name: Zenkyu
summary: Inquiry form for cafés, retailers and partners who want to carry Zenkyu matcha.
facts: The form asks your monthly matcha need in kilograms, intended use and timeline
Says it replies within a few business days
Business type options on the inquiry form are Cafe, Restaurant, Tea Room / Matcha Bar, Distributor or Other

name: European Matcha Supplier
summary: Sells matcha wholesale and offers private-label matcha, shipped from a warehouse in Spain to businesses in Europe.
facts: Public shop shows each matcha with its price, from €0.089 per gram for Matcha Standard in 1 kg
Wholesale formats from 1 kg to tonnes, on request
Says its single-farm matcha comes from three family-run farms in Kagoshima, Shizuoka and Uji, Japan; it also lists organic-compliant matcha from Guizhou, China
Offers private-label matcha sourced from Japan and distributed across the EU (see its White Labelling page)
States delivery to Spain, France, the United Kingdom, Italy and Germany
Contact is through its Contact page or a customer-service WhatsApp line; the site recommends contacting them directly
hq: Marbella, Spain (also lists an address in Kyoto, Japan)

products: Matcha Asahi x Gokō, Gokō and Yabukita (Japan)
Matcha Supreme, Premium and Standard (China, Guizhou)
Matcha samples and a storage box
profile.organic: Says its Japanese matcha is 100% organic and its Chinese matcha complies with EU organic standards (no certificate is shown on the site)
profile.minimumOrder: The FAQ says the minimum order is 250 g; the home page says wholesale runs from 1 kg to tonnes. Bulk orders go to its B2B email address
profile.samples: 10 g samples are available for each matcha
certifications: Says it meets EU food regulations (no certificate shown on the site)
profile.customers: Businesses that want wholesale or private-label matcha
profile.privateLabel: Offers private-label (white-label) matcha sourced from Japan and distributed across the EU; see its White Labelling page
profile.shipping: Delivers to Spain, France, the United Kingdom, Italy and Germany; packed in its warehouse in Spain
profile.pricing: Public shop prices are shown below (from €89 to €289 per item). Bulk orders are by email; the FAQ says bulk orders need 50% upfront and 50% before shipment

catalog.name: Matcha Asahi x Gokō
catalog.notes: A rare blend of two Uji cultivars: Asahi brings creaminess and sweetness, Gokō brings umami and aromatic depth. The site describes notes of sweet cream, fresh butter and tender greens with a silky, lingering finish.
catalog.priceNote: Pack size is not stated on this product page. The site quotes wholesale matcha from €0.089 per gram, so confirm the size before ordering.

catalog.name: Matcha Gokō
catalog.notes: Gokō is described as a prestigious Uji cultivar historically used for high-end ceremonial matcha: deep umami, minimal bitterness, a smooth round mouthfeel, with notes of cooked greens, hazelnut and sweet cream.
catalog.priceNote: Pack size is not stated on this product page. The site quotes wholesale matcha from €0.089 per gram, so confirm the size before ordering.

catalog.name: Matcha Yabukita
catalog.notes: A smooth, well-rounded matcha with clean umami, mild vegetal notes, a subtle floral note and a gentle bitterness. The site says it holds its character with milk and other ingredients and turns brighter green in food.
catalog.priceNote: Pack size is not stated on this product page. The site quotes wholesale matcha from €0.089 per gram, so confirm the size before ordering.

catalog.name: Matcha Supreme
badges: Listed as “Supreme Organic” in its sample list
catalog.notes: Described as deeply umami with strong character and minimal bitterness: a smooth, round mouthfeel with notes of cooked greens, hazelnut and sweet cream.
catalog.priceNote: Pack size is not stated on this product page. The site quotes wholesale matcha from €0.089 per gram, so confirm the size before ordering.

catalog.name: Matcha Premium
catalog.notes: Described as deeply umami and very green, with a very good foam, a round mouthfeel and subtle vegetal notes.
catalog.priceNote: Pack size is not stated on this product page. The site quotes wholesale matcha from €0.089 per gram, so confirm the size before ordering.

catalog.name: Matcha Standard
badges: Listed as “Standard Organic” in its sample list
catalog.notes: Clean umami, mild vegetal notes and a pleasant bitterness. The site positions it as the balance of quality and value for sweetened lattes, desserts and food; the dry colour is less vibrant than its higher grades but brightens in recipes.
catalog.price: €89 for 1 kg (€0.089 per gram)

catalog.name: Matcha sample
catalog.notes: A 10 g sample of any of the matchas, as a one-time trial. The site suggests 2 g per serving, so about 5 servings.
options: Choose the matcha: Asahi x Gokō, Gokō, Yabukita, Supreme, Premium or Standard

catalog.name: Matcha Fresh Box (1200 ml)
catalog.notes: A 1200 ml storage container with a press-to-vacuum lid, to keep matcha away from air and moisture.

catalogNote: Storage advice on every product page: keep in a cool, dry place away from light, refrigerate before and after opening, and use within 3 months of opening. The wholesale catalogue itself is behind a sign-up form, so only its public shop items are shown.
